resources.string: NOVA
Connect to your NOVA server
Enter the address your NOVA server shows when you start it on your PC, e.g. http://192.168.1.5:3000. Your phone must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Server address
Connect
Connecting…
Checking %1$s…
Your account and everything in it stay on that server. This app only opens it.
Enter the address your NOVA server shows, like http://192.168.1.5:3000.
Use an address that starts with http:// or https://.
Put an IPv6 address in square brackets, like http://[fd00::5]:3000.
That doesn\'t look like a server address. Try something like http://192.168.1.5:3000.
Couldn\'t reach %1$s. Check that the NOVA server is running on your PC and that your phone is on the same Wi-Fi.
NOVA usually runs on port 3000, so the address may need :3000 on the end.
%1$s didn\'t answer in time. The PC may be asleep, or Windows Firewall may be blocking Node.js on private networks.
The server at %1$s answered but took too long to send its page. If you\'ve only just started it, it may still be getting ready: wait a few seconds and tap Connect again.
%1$s means this phone itself, not your PC. Use the Network address the NOVA server prints when it starts, like http://192.168.1.5:3000.
%1$s forwards to a different address, %2$s. If that is your NOVA server, enter it instead. If not, check the address and port.
Couldn\'t find %1$s. Check the spelling, or use the PC\'s IP address instead.
Couldn\'t make a secure connection to %1$s: this phone doesn\'t trust its certificate. For a server on your Wi-Fi, use the http:// address.
Something answered at %1$s, but it isn\'t a NOVA server. Check the port number.
The NOVA server at %1$s answered with an error (HTTP %2$d). Check the window where it is running on your PC.
Can\'t reach your NOVA server
Couldn\'t load %1$s
This usually means one of these:
Your PC is off or asleep, or the NOVA server isn\'t running on it.
Your phone isn\'t on the same Wi-Fi as the PC.
The PC\'s address changed. Check the Network address the server prints when it starts.
Retry
Retrying…
Change server
The server answered HTTP %1$d.
This phone doesn\'t trust the server\'s security certificate.
The server sent the app on to %1$s, which is a different address. If NOVA has moved there, tap Change server and enter it.
No app on this phone can open that link.
Change server
